The logistics properties portfolio is valued at approximately $4.9 billion and measures over 28.4 million square feet. There are 33 properties located in the U.S, totaling 19.2 million square feet.

headline: CBRE Group acquires occupancy planning and technology services company
summary: CBRE Group has acquired Buildingi, an occupancy planning and technology services company. Buildingi will join CBRE’s Occupancy Management unit and shift its branding to Buildingi from CBRE. According to its website, Buildingi was started in 1994 and offers space utilization data management and computer-aided design technology that will help support CBRE’s occupancy management offering.
